signals.text: Foden sees red as Mainoo impresses - Manchester derby ratings. How Manchester United and Manchester City players rated in the derby clash at Old Trafford.
Struggling Preston North End sack Heckingbottom. Preston North End sack Paul Heckingbottom after six defeats in seven league games left the Lilywhites second bottom of the Championship.

Chelsea's defence looks 'weak & disjointed' - analysis. Match of the Day pundit Ashley Williams says Chelsea's "struggling" defence looked "weak and disjointed" in their 2-2 draw against Hull at Stamford Bridge.
Arsenal monitoring Como's Paz - Sunday's gossip. Arsenal are monitoring Nico Paz, Liverpool and Aston Villa are tracking Cher Ndour and Sunderland are refusing to give up on Geny Catamo, plus more.
Souttar's Rangers exit in doubt - gossip. Move to Greece is off for frozen out Rangers defender as former player is linked with post at Ibrox...
